Problem Statement:
Write a program to find the digital root of a number. 
Input Description:
A single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^9). 
Output Description:
Print the digital root. 
Sample Input:
9875 
Sample Output:
2 
Explanation:
Keep summing the digits of a number until a single-digit remains.
